req.title: Update only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to update a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to update it. This is a critical authorization check to ensure data integrity and user privacy. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: Update by Author
preconditions: User Rahul is the author of post with id 2
actions: Attempt to update post with id 2
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Login as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Update post with id 2
r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})

assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Updated Title' in r.data

tests.name: Update by Non-Author
preconditions: User Anjali is not the author of post with id 2
actions: Attempt to update post with id 2
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Login as Anjali
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})

# Attempt to update post with id 2
r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Unauthorized Update', 'body': 'This should fail'})

assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: Boundary Case: Update with Max Length Title
preconditions: User Rahul is the author of post with id 2
actions: Attempt to update post with id 2 using max length title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Login as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Update post with id 2 using max length title
max_length_title = 'X' * 120
r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': max_length_title, 'body': 'Boundary Test Body'})

assert r.status_code == 200
assert max_length_title.encode() in r.data
